This template helps editors create exercises for readers. The definition is:
<pre>{{dynamic navigation
|titlestyle=text-align:left;
|title = {{{question|(This lesson is incomplete. Click "edit" to provide an example.)}}}
|body = {{{answer|<small>When you find the answer, you can add it here by clicking "edit".</small>}}}
}}</pre>

Here is an example:
<pre>{{Question-answer|question=Who am I?|answer=the Question-answer template}}</pre>

This results in:
{{Question-answer|question=Who am I?|answer=the Question-answer template}}

</noinclude>
